entries.positive_observation: The compact round yellow mascot has green-ringed solid black eyes without white sclera, one restrained closed mouth, and no human nose, ears or skin. The dark olive peaked cap retains its shiny black visor, gold braid and oakleaf detailing, separate upper gold eagle and lower gold wreath/cockade. Short gray temple/sideburn hair and both dark brown eyebrows remain; there are no glasses, moustache or beard. The nearly frontal upright pose, direct gaze, stern expression, crop and under-cap shadow remain recognizable. The dark olive closed-collar tunic retains two red gold-embroidered collar patches, two gold shoulder boards and one small round gold throat button, without duplicated ornaments. The rounded chin meets a short broad naturally fitted collar without a neck stalk, pinching, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. The pale warm greige mottled backplate fills the original rectangle; no frame, note, replacement backdrop or watermark was added.
entries.alpha_decision: visible-alpha-v1: the exact source is RGBA 156x210 with alpha extrema [255,255] and all 32760 pixels at alpha 255. The full white/cyan/source-alpha sheet and complete unchanged RGB raw show an intact opaque rectangular backplate with no holes, halo, smoke or transparent exterior. The returned 1776x2368 master is RGB, so returned_alpha_extrema is null and no native_alpha_accepted claim applies. RGB art is approved only for the later source-compatible BILINEAR alpha-only restoration of this fully opaque source alpha, followed by a separate final visual review. No repair was performed in this review.
entries.visible_limitations: At 156x210, the finest cap and collar embroidery, small cockade interior and shoulder-board weave are not fully readable. Their visible shapes, counts and placement were checked without claiming microscopic heraldic detail; these genuine source-resolution limits are not rejection grounds.
